recommendation.finding: Five open orders have no promised date, so none can be late by date and no build can count on them. The one that matters is the Vistaray safety lidar line (HPO-26-00627/20, 314 EA), which feeds Tern T2 at 1 per robot and Porter P5 at 2 per robot. The other four are small, and for three of them (the Yokohama capacitor, the Tri-State threadlocker and the Brightcharge charging dock unit) no parent build was found. I logged a question for Marcus Chen, Sofia Marino and Priya Nair on their lines, asking for the promised date and whether the line is still open. No supplier email was staged, because all five questions sit with Halden buyers.
assumptions: Stock on hand is unknown, so these lines cannot be said to cover or miss any build.
would_change: The promised dates from Marcus Chen, Sofia Marino and Priya Nair, once they get them from the suppliers.
A confirmation that any of the five lines is already closed, which would remove it from supply.
